title: When the Scholarship Sings
author: Coral Joubert
blurb: Wren Sandoval, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
